version_checked: Cubase Pro 14.0.30 operation manual (Default Key Commands); Cubase Pro 15.0.30 list compared — identical keys except Navigate gains Page Up / Page Down
mac_mapping: Steinberg writes Ctrl/Cmd (= ⌘ on macOS), Alt/Opt (= ⌥), Shift (= ⇧). The Media category's bare "Ctrl-Alt/Opt-Num" is ⌥⌘ + keypad on a Mac (seen in a real Mac Key Commands.xml). Cubase "Return" = Enter (main key), Cubase "Enter" = NumpadEnter, "Num x" = Numpad keys.

rows.equivalent: Preferences… (Cubase Pro application menu on macOS; Edit > Preferences on Windows)
rows.note: Not in Steinberg's default key list; ⌘, is the macOS application-menu convention and a Steinberg forum post says Cubase keeps ⌘, for Preferences. Verify in Key Commands. A real Cubase Key Commands.xml from a Mac has no key on Edit | Preferences, so ⌘, would only come from the macOS app menu.
